title: Data-Driven Mechanism Design via Multi-Agent Revealed Preferences
abstract: arXiv:2404.15391v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study a sequence of independent one-shot non-cooperative games where agents play equilibria determined by a tunable mechanism. Observing only equilibrium decisions, without parametric or distributional knowledge of utilities, we aim to steer equilibria towards social optimality, and to certify when this is impossible due to the game's structure. We develop an adaptive RL framework for this mechanism design objective. First, we derive a multi-agent revealed-preference test for Pareto optimality that gives necessary and sufficient conditions for the existence of utilities under which the empirically observed mixed-strategy Nash equilibria are socially optimal. The conditions form a tractable linear program. translated_title: 基于多智能体显示偏好的数据驱动机制设计
translated_abstract: 我们研究一系列独立的一次性非合作博弈，其中智能体在由可调机制所决定的均衡下进行博弈。在仅观察均衡决策、且不掌握效用函数的参数或分布信息的情况下，我们的目标是将均衡引导至社会最优，并在由于博弈结构本身而无法实现时给出认证。为此，我们针对这一机制设计目标开发了一个自适应强化学习框架。首先，我们推导了一个针对帕累托最优性的多智能体显示偏好检验，给出了存在效用函数使得经验观察到的混合策略纳什均衡为社会最优的充要条件，这些条件构成一个易于求解的线性规划。基于此，我们构建了一个逆强化学习（IRL）步骤来计算帕累托差距（即观察到的策略与帕累托最优之间的距离），并将其与策略梯度更新相结合。我们证明了算法收敛到一个全局最小化……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于多智能体显示偏好的自适应强化学习机制设计框架，利用可求解的线性规划检验帕累托最优性并计算帕累托差距，从而仅凭观察到的均衡决策就能将博弈均衡引导至社会最优。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an adaptive RL framework for data-driven mechanism design that uses a tractable linear-programming multi-agent revealed-preference test to certify Pareto optimality and compute the Pareto gap, steering game equilibria toward social optimality from observed equilibrium decisions alone.
